note: Golden retrieval set for the FOOTBALL OS knowledge base. Queries are phrased the way a player types them. expected_documents is the set of corpus slugs that legitimately answer the question. The out_of_scope list is not only a refusal test: it carries one question per single-floor shape (fee-winger clears the coverage floor and fails the match floor; weight-diet clears the match floor and fails the coverage floor), so deleting either clause from `answerable` answers something the door must refuse. That property is recomputed on every run by tests/test_knowledge_rag.py::test_the_answerability_floors_sit_inside_the_measured_gap.
